CheckTitle: RDS instances are deployed across multiple availability zones
Description: Ensure that RDS instances are deployed across multiple availability zones for high availability.
Risk: RDS instances deployed in a single availability zone are vulnerable to availability zone failures, which can cause database downtime.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Relational Database Service.
3. Select the instance.
4. Click More > Create Standby Instance to enable cross-AZ deployment.
5. Select a different availability zone for the standby.
6. Click Save.

Recommendation.Text: Deploy RDS instances across multiple availability zones to ensure high availability.
